sources.disposition: Official SharePoint redirect returned 403. User-supplied direct OneDrive folder URL also returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-10; browser navigation redirected to the university Microsoft account sign-in page. No anonymous file listing or authorized media download established; no verified author-provided mirror. Author advertises 100 snooker recordings, including 16 manual-path-image examples, not 116 independent shots. No numerical cue-action labels verified.

Three short unlabelled clips acquired and decoded. Sampled-frame triage found cropped table coverage and camera motion, without verified complete stationary endpoint pairs. Zero accepted primary tasks; file count is not shot count.

Complete pinned raw snapshot acquired locally on 2026-10-10 at revision dcbcdf46b71c30e76bf51220f697836abd9c60bf: 54 files,149838665026 bytes,32 videos totalling228.38 hours and21 corner JSON sidecars. All source checksums and video stream probes passed; no authentication used. Explicit user acquisition request is not a media licence: source-use rights remain unverified and benchmark/training eligibility remains blocked. No accepted labelled single-shot tasks yet.

Author reports four snooker broadcasts with scorebox/event annotations, not ball trajectories. Archive HEAD 200 was followed by an error HTML page on GET; no sample media URL or broadcast grant verified.

Repository has three input MP4 files; sample1.mp4 HEAD 200, 22967521 bytes. README CC BY 4.0 statement concerns the labelled detection dataset, not an explicit media grant. sample1.mp4 duplicates Zulfi2003 snooker_video1.mp4 by Git blob ID.
Repository has five input MP4s plus one processed output, not six independent recordings. Input video4 HEAD 200, 7366947 bytes. No media licence or recording ownership statement verified.
